question: Whirlpool Whelm clashes with an opponent and returns a target creature. Do I choose the target creature after seeing the clash result?

expected.shortAnswer: No: you choose the target when you cast it, not when you clash.
expected.answer: You choose the target when you play Whirlpool Whelm, not when you clash.
